`Brick.ttl` release. All 19,752 triples without blank nodes matched the
official release exactly.

The catalogue copy removes two `schema:email` triples containing public
maintainer email addresses. Names required for source attribution remain.
No other semantic changes were made.

Brick is classified as external standards content rather than a
community-authored example. The Brick name is retained for attribution and
does not imply Microsoft endorsement.
